subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: the WorkTracker port is a **consumer-side Go interface** — the engine declares what it needs; the localfs adapter implements it in its own package; the engine core imports the port, never the adapter (the hexagon boundary, AGENTS.md Go rules, lint-enforced). The interface is kept free of file-isms (no paths, no formats in its signatures) so the future extraction (§3.2/Q4) is clean. Every method takes `context.Context` first and returns typed domain structs plus a typed `Defect` (the docgate boundary-error pattern reused): create · get · edit · transition · comment · addSignal/removeSignal · setParent/clearParent · addDep/removeDep · appendDecisionRecord · list · search · readySet · triageSet · defineSignal.
